description: Lists the TCP ports Shodan has seen open on an IPv4 address, from its pre-collected passive scan data (not a live scan: nothing connects to the address now). The record can be days old, and an address with no record returns known=false, which does not prove the ports are closed. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_open_port_scanner
title: Security Open Port Scanner
